series.title: The Champagne Liar

characters.name: Lemon Lenny
characters.look: A bright yellow lemon man with a smug grin, slicked-back leafy hair, in a shiny too-big gold suit and a borrowed bow tie.

characters.name: Strawberry Sofia
characters.look: A sweet red strawberry woman with green leafy curls, big hopeful eyes, in an elegant pink evening dress and pearl earrings.

characters.name: Madame Plum
characters.look: A plump purple plum lady with a raised eyebrow and lorgnette glasses, wearing a fur-trimmed violet gown and a sparkling tiara.

characters.name: Potato Pierre
characters.look: A small humble brown potato man with calm kind eyes and a neat little mustache, in a crisp black waiter's vest and white gloves.

so_far: Part 1: Broke Lemon Lenny lies to Madame Plum that he owns a champagne empire and the fancy restaurant, then gets handed a giant bill and a mysterious note from the quiet waiter.
Part 2: Pierre confronts Lenny in the kitchen and demands he tell Sofia the truth, but Lenny fills the champagne bottles with sour lemon water instead, raising Madame Plum's suspicions.
series.cliffhanger: Pierre reveals who really owns the restaurant in front of everyone, and Lenny's champagne empire is about to crumble.

history.title: His Best Friend Swapped the Plans at Midnight (Part 1)
history.premise: The Bulldozer Betrayal (part 1): Carrot Carl secretly swaps Broccoli Bob's blueprints, making Bob sink the boss's trailer and get fired while Carl takes his bulldozer.

history.title: The Fired Worker Found the Fake Blueprint (Part 2)
history.premise: The Bulldozer Betrayal (part 2): Bob finds the fake blueprint covered in orange dust, Carl nearly crushes the evidence with the bulldozer, and Mr Pineapple catches them both just as Carl blames Bob.

history.title: One Orange Smudge Exposed the Real Saboteur (Part 3)
history.premise: The Bulldozer Betrayal (part 3): Mr Pineapple traces the carrot dust to Carl, who flees in the bulldozer and sinks it in the mud pit, while Bob rescues him, becomes foreman and gets his bulldozer back.

history.premise: The Champagne Liar (part 2): Pierre confronts Lenny in the kitchen and demands he tell Sofia the truth, but Lenny fills the champagne bottles with sour lemon water instead, raising Madame Plum's suspicions.
